Two sound waves P and Q are displayed on an oscilloscope with the same time-base and
Y-plate settings for each.
P
Q
Which statement correctly describes the pitch and the loudness of the two sounds?
A
P has a higher pitch and is louder than Q.
B
P has a higher pitch and is quieter than Q.
C
P has a lower pitch and is louder than Q.
D
P has a lower pitch and is quieter than Q.

options.label: A
options.text: P has a higher pitch and is louder than Q.

options.label: B
options.text: P has a higher pitch and is quieter than Q.

options.label: C
options.text: P has a lower pitch and is louder than Q.

options.label: D
options.text: P has a lower pitch and is quieter than Q.
